stem_book: One mole of an ideal monoatomic gas is subjected to changes as shown in the graph (P in bar vs V in L): 1 (20 L, 1.0 bar) → 2 (40 L, 1.0 bar) at constant pressure; 2 → 3 (40 L, 0.5 bar) at constant volume; 3 → 1 back to (20 L, 1.0 bar) along the reversible isotherm (curve, PV constant). The magnitude of the work done (by the system or on the system) is ______ J (nearest integer). Given: log 2 = 0.3, ln 10 = 2.3; 1 bar L = 100 J.
reason: Printed key reads 6, working (and official JEE answer) is 620 J. Isothermal nature of curve 3→1 (P1V1 = P3V3 = 20 bar L) and 1 bar L = 100 J made explicit.
